title: Reject invalid amounts and dates in MisPagos rows
notes: A synthetic MisPagos row with the amount and date cells exchanged yielded an incorrect payment amount or date in the CLI report and existing JSON import path.
done_when: The payment reader refuses a row with an invalid amount or date before emitting a report. The standard Spanish amount and date layout continues to work.
result: Reject invalid amounts and dates in MisPagos rows
evidence: MisPagos now rejects invalid Spanish amounts and impossible calendar dates before returning payment rows. The cross-project synthetic replay confirmed that the swapped amount/date row is rejected while both standard payments retain their NRC, amount and date. pnpm exec vitest run src/aeat/payments src/aeat/accountPayment src/aeat/debts passed 114 tests. pnpm check:ci passed all 2,473 tests.
